# ENCLAVE

> Private by Design: Ephemeral, end-to-end encrypted rooms for real-time communication that leave zero permanent traces.

ENCLAVE is a zero-knowledge communication platform providing ephemeral chambers for encrypted text messaging and WebRTC video/voice calls. Rooms operate purely in volatile memory; when participants leave, keys and state are permanently destroyed.

## Core Architectural Invariants
- **Ephemeral Rooms**: Client-side generated chambers with zero persistent disk retention.
- **Two-Factor Access Separation**: Room URL and out-of-band access pass keep decryption keys isolated.
- **End-to-End Encryption**: Authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption with Argon2id + HKDF derivation.
- **Zero Account Obligation**: Guests join instantly via modern browsers without registration.
- **Memory Zeroization**: Memory buffers overwritten with random noise upon session exit.
